config.title: FUNDA — Expandable FAQ Accordion

intro.title: FUNDA — Expandable FAQ Accordion
intro.body: In this lesson you will build an Expandable FAQ Accordion — a set of question/answer panels where clicking a question expands it with a smooth animation while collapsing any other open panel (exclusive open mode) or allowing multiple open panels (multi-open mode). You will architect it as a parent AccordionComponent that uses @ContentChildren to discover its AccordionItemComponent children projected via ng-content, coordinate their open/close state from the parent, and apply Angular Animations for smooth height transitions.
intro.usecase: Accordions, tab groups, steppers, and disclosure panels share the same architectural pattern: a parent component that orchestrates the state of multiple projected child components — the pattern inside Angular Material's MatExpansionPanel and MatStepper.

objectives: Design an AccordionComponent and AccordionItemComponent pair where items are projected into the parent via ng-content
Use @ContentChildren(AccordionItemComponent) in the parent to get a QueryList of all projected child items
Implement exclusive open mode by iterating over QueryList and calling close() on all siblings when one item opens
Support a multi-open @Input on the accordion parent that switches between exclusive and multi-open behaviour
Apply an Angular Animation trigger on the content panel using the :enter and :leave states with style({height: 0}) transitions
Use ngAfterContentInit to subscribe to QueryList.changes and handle items added or removed dynamically after initial render
Add keyboard navigation (arrow keys to move between items, Space/Enter to toggle) and ARIA expanded attributes for accessibility
